title: Battery (DC Power & Voltage)
summary: A battery stores chemical energy and converts it into electrical potential (voltage) to drive direct current.

title: LED (Light Emitting Diode)
summary: A light-emitting diode glows when current flows from anode (+) to cathode (-).

title: Resistor (Current Limiter)
summary: A resistor limits current so components like LEDs do not burn out according to Ohm's Law.

title: Buzzer (Piezo Sounder)
summary: A piezo buzzer vibrates rapidly to produce loud warning tones and musical frequencies.

title: SSD (7-Segment Display)
summary: An SSD combines 7 LED segments in a figure-8 pattern to render clear digits 0 to 9.

title: Buzzers and sound
summary: A buzzer makes sound when powered; tone() sets its pitch.

title: If-else decisions
summary: If-else lets a program choose what to do based on a condition.

title: Ultrasonic distance sensor
summary: HC-SR04 sends sound pulses and times the echo to measure distance.

title: Variables
summary: A variable is a named box that stores a value, like distance or count.

title: Ground and complete circuits
summary: Current needs a complete path back to ground (GND) for a circuit to work.

title: Motors and motor drivers
summary: Motors need more current than pins give, so a motor driver controls them.

title: Line follower robot
summary: IR sensors detect a dark line and the robot steers to stay on it.

title: What is AI
summary: AI lets computers learn patterns from examples to make decisions.

title: Image recognition basics
summary: AI models learn to recognise objects in pictures from many labelled examples.

title: Servo motors and angles
summary: A servo turns to an exact angle between 0 and 180 degrees.
